gap: BHD IS UNCHANGED, so scope does not decide this; ours loses on design. SCOPE, measured by isolation in ONE session with data held constant, data-product forced bhd-erp, accent verified #009bc1 on every capture, wave rules deleted by data-vite-dev-id matching /style/wave/ (326 rules from wave/index.css) plus any surviving rule carrying the pnp scope. The kill was itself verified before use: with pnp forced, after the kill the table header reverts to UPPERCASE and the rail to 220px and 0 pnp rules survive, so the OFF frames really are wave-free. Differing pixels, OFF vs ON: /customer 0 of 5,184,000, /invoice 0 of 5,184,000, /payment 0 of 5,184,000, dashboard 1440x900 6,380 of 5,184,000 (0.1231%) inside bbox css (754,813)-(905,899) which is the animated donut - the CONTROL, two consecutive ON runs with nothing toggled, is 6,521 px (0.1258%) over a LARGER bbox, so ON-vs-OFF sits below the noise floor - and dashboard 390x844 103 of 1,316,640 (0.0078%) at css (338,89)-(344,96), which I cropped and read: it is a clock, '04:11' in one frame and '04:12' in the other. Against the stored baselines the numbers are large (dashboard 47.03%, invoice 18.38%, customer 5.93%, dashboard-m 45.35%) and it is all DATA: I cropped both and the KPI strip has a different card set entirely (37 records and an Expired Date column then, 10 records and an 'Evidence Incomplete' card wrapping to two lines now), while every BHD chrome element is byte-identical - 220px labelled rail, teal Add New, UPPERCASE sort-caret headers, lowercase 'search' placeholders, same button treatments. REAL PROGRESS since r7, all verified by rasterisation not by declaration: the typeface seam INSIDE the empty block is gone - .wave-empty__title, .wave-empty__text and .wave-empty__btn all rasterise Inter now, where r7 had the headline in Plus Jakarta Sans and the button in Inter 100px below it. The desktop block is well composed: card y=274-675, placeholder y=326-674, the tile+headline+sentence+pill group y=370-630, centred with 44px of air top and bottom, table header retained above it, one white rounded container with a soft border and no drop shadow. /customer matches /invoice exactly. Both are genuinely good screens. It still does not clearly win, for four reasons. (1) THE PIECE IS EMPTY STATES, PLURAL, AND THE PRODUCT SHIPS TWO GRAMMARS. /payment - a core financial list that is genuinely empty, no query involved, the state a new tenant meets on day one - renders no .wave-empty at all. It renders AntD's default: Title Case 'No Data Found', no sentence, no action, nothing to do, on a toolbar that offers only Filters / Export to Excel / Refresh. This is not an accident of one page: WaveEmpty.jsx is reached through ConfigProvider renderEmpty, which AntD makes dead code the moment a table passes locale.emptyText, and 94 files under pages/ pass one (116 occurrences), plus components/DataTable/MobileCardList.jsx:80 builds its own <Empty image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}> for the phone. Two shared DataTables were converted. The random core list I sampled was not. A product that reads expensive is expensive on the boring screen too. (2) /payment ALSO still carries the header-band defect named in r3, r6 and r7. I cropped it at 2x: the pale band ramps darker toward the right of 'Payment Mode' and then STEPS at a hard vertical hairline into a lighter panel that owns the rounded top-right corner, so one header row reads as two mismatched tones. Every th reports the same rgb(241,244,249), so this is AntD's sticky-column ping shadow painted over the wave band and never addressed. It is not 'fixed on /invoice and not /payment' - /invoice and /customer simply do not overflow, so .ant-table-ping-right never fires there; /payment and /quote both fire it, and both show the seam. Any list wide enough to scroll gets it. (3) THE TOOLBAR DIRECTLY ABOVE THE EMPTY BLOCK IS FOUR CONTROL SPECIES WHERE THE BAR IS TWO. Measured on /invoice: input 280x40 radius 8px white; Filter select 40px radius 8px GREY FILLED, which reads disabled beside its neighbours; Export to Excel and Refresh 40px radius 999px white with a grey #cfd9e8 border and a dark label; Add New Invoice 40px radius 999px transparent with a BLUE border and a blue label; plus a bare 32x18 switch. The bar's row is three identical outlined blue pills and one plain white field - one family, two treatments. /customer is worse: six shapes, including a two-cell segmented toggle with one cell filled blue and a naked 40px circular gear, the only circle in a row of pills. And the two lists share no toolbar vocabulary at all. (4) THE INPUT PLACEHOLDER IS STILL THE LOWERCASE WORD 'search', unaddressed for three rounds, sitting on the exact screen being judged, while every neighbour is Title Case (Filter, Export to Excel, Show Deleted, Refresh, Add New Invoice) and the empty state's own copy is carefully written sentence case. It is inherited verbatim from BHD - I can see the identical lowercase 'search' in the BHD baseline crop - so it is not a Paper & Pen decision, it is an un-made one. /invoice says 'Filter', /payment says 'Filters'. TWO SMALLER THINGS. Three text faces still rasterise on the empty screen: 'Paper & Pen' and 'Invoice List' in Plus Jakarta Sans, the breadcrumb 'Invoices' in IBM Plex Sans Arabic, everything else in Inter - so the same ROLE, a headline, uses Plus Jakarta at the top of the card and Inter 230px below it. And the 40px 'AI Assistant (locked) - click to configure' circle is still fixed at css (1388,844) on desktop and (357,751) on mobile, advertising a locked feature on a screen about finding records; on desktop it is hidden in my capture only because the TanStack devtools button sits on top of it, which is dev-only and correctly discounted. NOT COUNTED AGAINST THE PIECE, but the next agent should know: the mark in the rail header is the bundled asset /src/style/images/bhd-logo-color.svg served with alt='Paper & Pen', so the flagship's top-left corner is BHD's yellow-and-blue logo. That is an appshell/foundation item, not an empty-state one.
